_meta.source: SCImago Journal Rank (SJR) - overall rank, best-quartile, and journal h-index
_meta.note: Metric order [sjr_percentile, sjr_quartile, sjr_rank, h_index]. Percentile = 100*(1-(rank-1)/N) over that year's N ranked journals, so it is comparable across years (raw rank is not: ~17k journals in 1999 grew to ~32k by 2024). Quartile is 1-4 (1=Q1, best). Rank/percentile/quartile are per publication year (pre-1999 uses 1999); h-index is a per-journal snapshot on every entry.
_meta.attribution: SCImago (n.d.). SJR - SCImago Journal & Country Rank [Portal]. Retrieved from https://www.scimagojr.com - used non-commercially.
